resourceEvidence.peakMemory: one-second requested samples, includes page cache

limitations: clientTaskSettled covers upload and download verification; production uploadFile does not consume signal, and the cancellation send guard covers requests associated before route teardown
Docker storage counters may omit cached/overlay writes; zero is not proof of no physical I/O
Memory sampling can miss transient peaks; actual sample cadence is archived
Queue head age is unavailable when the broker omits head_message_timestamp
Cleanup removes verified benchmark objects; production retention is unverified
Marginal p99 intervals assume independent samples; correlated queueing can widen uncertainty
Worker restart counter resets can omit CPU/IO between the final pre-stop sample and termination
